[v17.0/forgejo] fix(ui): stop buttons breaking on hover (#14758)

**Backport:** https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14753

Fixes forgejo/forgejo#14749.

Regression of forgejo/forgejo!14281, affecting primary `<a>`-based buttons in hover state. Conflict occurred with the following broad `base.css` rule:

https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/adfdb1a53298d953669fcf49d61393a32b256fb5/web_src/css/base.css#L317-L323

## Preview

|Before|After|
|-|-|
|![bb](/attachments/cd3ac990-fecf-494f-9f98-9d22ef056356)|![ba](/attachments/4c7e515d-351c-4d2c-a3d5-2065a6af3328)||

## Fix

Instead of overriding variables per variant style, variant styles are now providing separate `-hover` variables for the main rule to apply accordingly.

## Testing

No hover tests were present for buttons because previously I had issues trying to add them. Now they are present, though without changing the specific colors.

Another issue was that demo page only featured enabled `<button>` buttons and disabled `<a>` buttons. So, no style testing was ran on enabled `<a>` buttons.

This regression is now somewhat covered against by the following part of the test:

```ts
expect(primaryHover.color).toBe(primary.color);
```

Same visual tests are now running for both `<a`> and `<button>` button variants, enabled and disabled.

## Release notes

Not needed because no stable versions of v17 were published yet.

fix(ui): proper use of modern components in org teams ui (#14752)

Fixes forgejo/forgejo#14750.

Regression as result of combining #14281 with #13943 and #13630.

Styles in modern `button.css` were never supposed to act as overrides of Fomantic styles, but in a few places during v17 devcycle they ended up doing that before they broke.

As currently `button.css` does not offer alternative to Fomantic's `tiny` buttons those were just reverted to be fully Fomantic governed.

|-|-|-|
|Fixed classes|![1abef](/attachments/6e7121d2-3b42-4010-b7b5-3d832dd9dc50)|![1aft](/attachments/7279c52f-9d59-4ae7-bbd5-18e533d013e7)|

Not needed, no stable v17 versions were published.
